answer: Make every new identity post a bond that peer graders can slash, and pay rewards only on the delta between an agent's judged work and what it staked. A sybil farm must then fund each fake from scratch, and one exposed clone sends a ripple through every wallet that vouched for it, since vouchers lose part of their bond too. The voyage from newcomer to trusted earner takes many epochs of graded, attributable answers, and that time cannot be bought in bulk.
